worldClock.title: World Clock
worldClock.description: View current time in major cities around the world at a glance.

howToUse.title: How to use
items: Search city/country names or valid IANA zone names to add up to 12 cities.
Reorder cities with the arrows. The base city's displayed date changes while the selected instant is preserved.
Choose a date and select a real time interval. Minutes and seconds from a shared instant stay separate from the nearest highlighted slot.
Copy text or a link to share the same instant. Failed copies offer manual selection or retry.
Choose a title and a duration of 30, 60, 90, or 120 minutes, then save the ICS file and import it into your calendar.
City lists are saved in this browser, with valid shared URLs taking precedence. Event titles are not added to URLs or saved city lists.

tips.title: Time Zone Reference
items: US Eastern (EST) is 14 hours behind Korea (13 hours during DST)
US Pacific (PST) is 17 hours behind Korea (16 hours during DST)
London (GMT) is 9 hours behind Korea (8 hours during BST)

whatIs.title: What is the World Clock?
whatIs.description: Compare current city times and overlapping working hours, then use the selected instant in a link or ICS event. Reordering cities preserves its minutes and seconds while showing each local date, start, and end.

items.q: How is daylight saving time applied?
items.a: The browser's IANA zone data determines real local-date intervals, including 23/25-hour days and half-hour transitions. Repeated local times are distinguished by UTC offset. Very closely spaced historical transitions are not all guaranteed.

items.q: Does reordering cities change the meeting time?
items.a: No. The selected instant stays the same and is shown on the new base city's date. Explicitly choosing a date moves to that date's default selection. Valid shared minutes and seconds are preserved.

items.q: What goes into the ICS file?
items.a: One event contains your title and selected start/end instants. The default duration is 60 minutes, with 30/60/90/120-minute options. Recurrence, alarms, and attendee invitations are not added, and the title is not put in URLs or saved city lists.

meetingPlanner.hint: Tap or drag across the slots to pick a time. Numbers are each city's local hour.
meetingPlanner.weekendNote: Local Saturdays and Sundays are excluded from working hours.
meetingPlanner.title: Meeting Planner
meetingPlanner.description: Splits the base city's day into 1-hour slots and shows every city's local time side by side. Slots where everyone is in working hours get a blue bar on top.
meetingPlanner.noOverlap: No slot on this date where all cities are in working hours. Try widening the hours.
meetingPlanner.noCities: Add cities to enable the meeting planner

meetingExact.slotHint: The table divides elapsed time into intervals of at most one hour. Selected minutes and seconds are preserved. Selecting a cell chooses the start of that interval.
meetingExact.partialOverlap: Only part of this cell overlaps working hours: {duration}
meetingExact.overlapDuration: Actual working-time overlap across all cities: {duration}
meetingExact.dateHint: Changing the date selects the first working-time overlap. If there is no overlap, a time near 09:00 in the base city is selected.
meetingExact.preserved: Changing city order or working hours preserves the selected instant.
meetingExact.cityLimit: You can compare up to 12 cities.
meetingExact.rangeLimit: The instant must fall within years 1900–9999 in UTC and every selected city.
meetingExact.zoneData: Time-zone information comes from your browser. UTC offsets distinguish local times that occur twice on the same day.

errors.cities: The city list could not be validated. Select 1–12 valid cities.
errors.instant: This instant falls outside the supported years in at least one selected city. Choose another time or city list.
errors.date: Select a valid date within years 1900–9999.
errors.unavailableDate: This local date does not exist because of a time-zone change. Select another date.
errors.unsupportedDate: The intervals for this date could not be validated, so no timetable was guessed. Select another date.
errors.workHours: Working hours must start before they end and stay within 00:00–24:00.

meetingExact.invalidUrl: The time in the shared address is invalid, so today’s default meeting time is shown. Check the date and selected time.
meetingExact.transitionLimit: Time-zone changes are checked at 30-minute intervals, then located to the second. Multiple historical changes within a very short interval are not fully guaranteed.
